name: splash-postboot.txt
command:
set -eu
date -u
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id /proc/uptime /opt/minimal-saver/last-boot.log /opt/minimal-splash/last-boot.log
vconftool get memory/appfw/current_fullscreen_appid
sha256sum /usr/apps/com.samsung.tv.csfs/shared/res/homeloading.edj /usr/bin/app_resume /usr/bin/boot_splashscreen /opt/minimal-saver/Boot.dll /usr/apps/com.samsung.tv.spotlight-ss/lib/arm/libgl-demo-app.so
for p in /tmp/boot_splash_resumed /tmp/boot_splash_finished /tmp/.boot_splashscreen_run; do if test -e "$p"; then ls -l "$p"; else echo "ABSENT $p"; fi; done
systemctl show AT-HUB.service app-boot-manager.service -p Id -p Result -p ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic -p ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic
